The bug reports were AI-generated. The
vulnerabilities were real.
Core Lightning is shipping emergency fixes under
a two-week embargo and telling every node
operator to go offline until they land. Brandon
and Kate on the closest call Bitcoin has had.
Would you lock up 2.5x your down payment in
BTC to buy a house without selling it?
@coinbase's crypto mortgage is live nationwide:
conforming Fannie Mae first mortgage, a second
loan against your coins, no margin calls when
price drops. @katemparkman runs through who
it's for.
Was the Coldcard hack this cycle's FTX?
Every cycle bottoms on a black swan. Last time it
was an exchange; this time Bitcoiners lost their
cold storage and the price barely moved.
Brandon reads that as the bottom, unless 50k
says otherwise.
Ask a social-listening tool what your community
says on Discord and it comes back empty. A
server has no public index and no search API
returning every mention across it.
The only way in is a bot with real server
membership.
What that actually requires:
NEW: Vibewatch now reads your Discourse
forum too, not just Discord and Telegram chat.
Forum posts carry the considered take:
governance debates, long-form feedback. Chat
tools miss half the conversation. We score it
thread-aware, not reply-by-reply.
Announcing first-class support for buzz.xyz by
@blocks.
🐝 Ask your Vibewatch agent questions with full
context across a dozen social integrations.
🐝 Receive automatic weekly reports about what
your community is saying on socials.
Available today.
Core Lightning node operators are being told to
go offline while a two-week embargo holds.
Plus the first quantum-resistant Bitcoin
transaction mined on mainnet, Coinbase's
Bitcoin-backed mortgage goes nationwide, and
Strategy adds $1.59B to its reserve ↓
Today, @marshallmixing and @katemparkman
dig into:
• Critical vulnerabilities in Core Lightning:
maintainers told every node operator to upgrade
or restart with the --offline flag. Details under a
two-week embargo — the bugs surfaced through
AI-generated vulnerability reports that proved
real. If you run a Lightning node, act now.
• The first quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction
was mined on mainnet: @StarkWareLtd
submitted it through Marathon's Slipstream
service and shared the news live at Bitcoin Asia.
Non-standard transactions that work today at
roughly $150 each.
• @coinbase's Bitcoin-backed mortgage is live
nationwide: pledge 250% of the down payment
in BTC, get a conforming Fannie Mae first
mortgage plus a second loan against the coins.
No margin calls just because the price drops.
• Pakistan released a full licensing framework for
crypto exchanges, custody, lending, and
derivatives: apply by September 5 or cease
operations.
• Quick headlines: JPMorgan is considering its
own stablecoin per the Wall Street Journal,
HashKey Cloud joins Bitcoin staking on @Stacks,
and @galaxyhq says last week's rise was
Bitcoin's largest weekly dollar gain ever.
• Treasury tracker: @strive +1,110 BTC (21,356),
@EMPD_BTC -100 (1,179). Pipeline: Alpha Modus
signed a $254M PIPE for 3,170 BTC, Genius
Group plans $827M over five years, @_ALCPB
raising €21M. @strategy: no buys, no sells; +
$1.59B USD reserve, $136M more STRC bought
back.
• Follow us @goodforbtc for clips all week.
